name: McDonald's Egg McMuffin (No Canadian Bacon / Plain)
whyItWorks: Uses a real Grade A egg freshly cracked into a circular cooking ring on the grill. Served on a toasted English muffin with light butter or American cheese, avoiding greasy pork sausages or processed bacon.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order an Egg McMuffin without Canadian bacon. If lactose intolerant, ask for "No cheese" as well.
